grammar.purpose: Interpret laughter through the surrounding turn
grammar.explanation: 哈哈 writes a laugh, not an automatic insult or agreement. It can follow amusement, self-directed humour or relaxed banter. Who or what the joke targets depends on context. If the listener is uncomfortable, clarify rather than insisting that a laugh proves friendliness. Spoken laughter need not literally pronounce two citation syllables; these written examples are read as language practice.

examples.zh: 哈哈，我又把日期看错了。
examples.py: hā hā , wǒ yòu bǎ rì qī kàn cuò le .
examples.en: Ha ha, I misread the date again.

examples.zh: 你笑什么？我在笑自己的玩笑。
examples.py: nǐ xiào shén me ? wǒ zài xiào zì jǐ de wán xiào .
examples.en: What are you laughing at? My own joke.

examples.zh: 哈哈只是笑声，不能证明大家同意。
examples.py: hā hā zhǐ shì xiào shēng , bù néng zhèng míng dà jiā tóng yì .
examples.en: “Ha ha” is only laughter; it does not prove everyone agrees.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她写哈哈，所以一定在笑我。
commonMistakes.right: 她写哈哈，我先问她在笑什么。
commonMistakes.why: Laughter alone does not identify its target.

grammar.pattern: 用疑问语调提问，不必都有吗
grammar.purpose: Recognize a confirmation question in context
grammar.explanation: An utterance with statement word order can be a confirmation question through intonation and context: 你今天也来参加这个活动？ No 吗 is required. Question intonation does not erase Mandarin lexical tones; it is not a rule to replace every final syllable’s tone with a rise. Compare a question seeking confirmation with a statement giving confirmed information. These synthesized examples are practice, not a certified acoustic minimal-pair test.

examples.zh: 你今天也来参加这个活动？我确认一下。
examples.py: nǐ jīn tiān yě lái cān jiā zhè gè huó dòng ? wǒ què rèn yī xià .
examples.en: Are you also joining this event today? Let me confirm.

examples.zh: 他今天也来，我已经问过了。
examples.py: tā jīn tiān yě lái , wǒ yǐ jīng wèn guò le .
examples.en: He is joining today too; I have already asked.

examples.zh: 你说的时间是周五晚上？我怕记错了。
examples.py: nǐ shuō de shí jiān shì zhōu wǔ wǎn shang ? wǒ pà jì cuò le .
examples.en: The time you said was Friday evening? I am worried I remembered incorrectly.

commonMistakes.wrong: 没有吗，所以不能是问题。
commonMistakes.right: 没有吗，也可以用疑问语调确认。
commonMistakes.why: Question particles are not the only way to ask a question.

reading.title: Lively, not careless
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Read what changes with delivery and what must stay clear.

lines.zh: 屋里很静，朋友突然写了哈哈，笑的是自己看错日期。
lines.py: wū lǐ hěn jìng , péng you tū rán xiě le hā hā , xiào de shì zì jǐ kàn cuò rì qī .
lines.en: The room is quiet; the friend suddenly writes “ha ha,” laughing at her own date mistake.

lines.zh: 听者紧张，不一定是生气，先问干吗停下来，别猜心情。
lines.py: tīng zhě jǐn zhāng , bù yí dìng shì shēng qì , xiān wèn gàn má tíng xià lái , bié cāi xīn qíng .
lines.en: The listener’s nervousness is not necessarily anger; ask why she paused rather than guessing her mood.

lines.zh: 笑意明显，现场欢乐，气氛热烈，但这个话题仍要好好说明。
lines.py: xiào yì míng xiǎn , xiàn chǎng huān lè , qì fēn rè liè , dàn zhè gè huà tí réng yào hǎo hǎo shuō míng .
lines.en: The amusement is obvious and the atmosphere joyful and enthusiastic, but this topic still needs careful explanation.

lines.zh: 说得活、例子生动，会让普通感谢也动人；表演不是模糊发音的理由。
lines.py: shuō de huó , lì zi shēng dòng , huì ràng pǔ tōng gǎn xiè yě dòng rén ; biǎo yǎn bù shì mó hú fā yīn de lǐ yóu .
lines.en: Lively delivery and vivid examples can make ordinary thanks moving; performance is no excuse for unclear pronunciation.

lines.zh: 她听了玩笑就乐了，看着很精神，也自觉把速度放慢。
lines.py: tā tīng le wán xiào jiù lè le , kàn zhe hěn jīng shen , yě zì jué bǎ sù dù fàng màn .
lines.en: The joke amused her; she looks lively and conscientiously slows down.

lines.zh: 乐观不等于没有困难，快速不等于准确，表现要看实际完成的事。
lines.py: lè guān bù děng yú méi yǒu kùn nán , kuài sù bù děng yú zhǔn què , biǎo xiàn yào kàn shí jì wán chéng de shì .
lines.en: Optimism does not mean absence of difficulty, speed does not mean accuracy, and performance depends on actual accomplishments.

lines.zh: 她把问题念出来：你说的时间是周五晚上？然后等对方确认。
lines.py: tā bǎ wèn tí niàn chū lái : nǐ shuō de shí jiān shì zhōu wǔ wǎn shang ? rán hòu děng duì fāng què rèn .
lines.en: She reads the question aloud: the time you said was Friday evening? Then she waits for confirmation.

lines.zh: 状态不合适就休息，声音大小不能代替意思和声调。
lines.py: zhuàng tài bù hé shì jiù xiū xī , shēng yīn dà xiǎo bù néng dài tì yì si hé shēng diào .
lines.en: Rest if the condition is unsuitable; volume cannot replace meaning and lexical tones.

right.en: Because the notice is wrong, stop circulating the old notice first.

pairs.left: Besides watching programmes, I also listen to the radio.

right.zh: 除了看节目，我还听广播。
right.py: chú le kàn jié mù , wǒ hái tīng guǎng bō .
right.en: Besides watching programmes, I also listen to the radio.

pairs.left: Any of the other days works, except Friday.

right.zh: 除了周五，其他几天都可以。
right.py: chú le zhōu wǔ , qí tā jǐ tiān dōu kě yǐ .
right.en: Any of the other days works, except Friday.

natural.py: wǒ xiào de shì zì jǐ , bù shì nǐ .
natural.en: I am laughing at myself, not at you.

pragmatics.note: Humour should not override the other person’s interpretation.

natural.py: nǐ jīn tiān yě lái cān jiā huó dòng ?
natural.en: Are you joining the event today too?

conversation.title: The joke in the chat
conversation.context: Hear a question tone and understand a laugh in context.
conversation.goal: Understand laughter in context without assuming mockery

turns.pinyin: sù dù tài kuài , zěn me bàn ?
turns.meaning: What if the speed is too fast?
